name: Essential Energy Female Engineering Scholarship (SCU)
summary: Up to $30,000 over three years for a female SCU engineering student in second year or later.
key: This scholarship is for up to three years with a total maximum of $30,000.
who: In second, third or fourth year of the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), or Engineering and Business, at SCU.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.
catches: $10,000 a year full-time, pro rata for part-time.
